productionMode: Built-in image tool; two independent reference-backed concept boards
scope: Original concept art only; no runtime, sprite family or playability admission

prompts.a:
Create one polished premium fantasy mobile game CONCEPT BOARD, landscape ~1536x1024. This is a new BREACH princess level proposal, not a finished gameplay screenshot. Layout: LEFT about45percent is one large edge-to-edge portrait PLAYFIELD with a generous clear lower reaction lane; RIGHT about55percent is a large expressive new villain render plus three small physical-action studies and a clear short title. The supplied images are precise local character/style references: retain Lumi's blonde hair, pink rose dress, tiny crown, large turquoise eyes and glossy chibi proportions; retain Kit's round navy medieval helmet, expressive blue eyes and dark blue knight armour. Reference3 is his actual face orb. Reference4 is the exact glossy bevelled ceramic brick language. Do not redesign either hero. Premium high-detail 3D-rendered toy quality, glazed ceramic tiles, real clearcoat reflections, polished metal, soft studio highlights, rich but restrained colours, readable silhouettes. Dark calm background several stops below the foreground. Faces have readable pupils, brows and mouths. No space theme, no aliens, no snake, no yeti, no gorilla, no copied Nintendo characters. Show only minimal top pause/life dots/score; no written instructions inside playfield. The paddle sits almost at the bottom, with at least the lower quarter empty for ball reaction. Only Kit's SMALL FACE ORB at lower LEFT, warm copper/sage charge ring rather than blue; no full body blocking controls, no bottom track. Identical sized coloured rectangular bricks, no tiny required precision targets. The small physical-action studies are on the RIGHT outside gameplay, with restrained clear short captions. Keep the full image coherent and finished, no greybox, no flat placeholders, no diagram-heavy arrows or dense text.
BOARD A title: "BELLFORGE RUN". Smaller subtitle: "Korr · The Bell Tyrant".
Environment: a dark plum/charcoal foundry inside a medieval bell tower, dim stone arches and turning brass clockworks in the rear, tiny localized warm furnace glow, no huge bright lava backdrop.
LEFT portrait: upper-left is Korr, an original heavy FOUR-LEGGED ARMOURED BOAR with broad ruby-plum ceramic shoulder plates, gunmetal joints, ivory curved tusks, stubby strong hoofed legs, enormous polished snout and fierce mischievous amber eyes. He operates a bell-release lever with a front hoof, not human hands. Upper-right Lumi stands on a hanging mechanical bell-lift platform, worried but determined, full body safely readable; the lift chain and ratchet are visible. Three staggered short sloping bronze/stone ramps and open flank lanes occupy the upper third. One large iron bell-weight is visibly rolling down a ramp, another is deflected upward by a bright white ball; clear meaningful contact sparks and a small rotation blur, not floating decoration. Below are four short staggered rows of equal glossy teal/coral/plum bricks with broad openings and a couple of small cache emblems. Keep all bricks/ramp solids well above the large empty paddle return lane. The ball trajectory can reach the boar's broad body from the flanks. Show a small bronze bell returning along the opened ramp toward Korr, making the counterattack idea clear without a wall of arrows.
RIGHT: a magnificent large Korr rendered in three-quarter view, same boar, all four stout legs and tusks, convincing weight, gloss, armour and expressive face. Under him three horizontal physical-action studies labelled only "WIND UP", "DEFLECT", "STAGGER": hoof lever lifts a bell; normal ball smashes a rolling bell upward; bell rebounds into Korr's broad shoulder with startled eyes and readable recoil. Small final power vignette: Kit's existing medieval shield forms one solid curved ECHO GUARD deflector under a bell, with metallic engraved rings and restrained copper contact light, no long laser trail. This shows an optional physical counter, not a mandatory precision weak point.
Art priorities: beautiful playable portrait composition, truly mechanical rolling bells/tilting ramp pivots, existing princess identity, no humanoid long arms on the boar, no ape, no barrels or construction-scaffold copy.

BOARD B title: "TIDEWHEEL CITADEL". Smaller subtitle: "Nerra · Keeper of the Flood".
Environment: a moonless drowned castle aqueduct, deep petrol-teal and blue-black stone, rain-streaked arches, distant dim sea through narrow windows. Foreground wet stone, coral/sage glazed tiles and aged silver wheel hardware shine clearly; background water remains very dark.
LEFT portrait: upper-left a gigantic original HERMIT-CRAB QUEEN with a ruined mini-fortress spiralling naturally from her shell, deep oxblood/coral shell plates, black pearl joints, TWO huge asymmetrical front claws, four pairs of short articulated walking legs and expressive eyes on short armoured stalks. She is a real crab creature, no human torso/arms, no bow or human costume. One claw holds a broad sluice wheel and the other lifts a water gate, preparing a surge. Upper-right Lumi stands on a raised pale stone refuge balcony above the water, gripping a railing, determined face with big clear turquoise eyes; no cage.
Two broad counterweighted floating rafts in the middle carry identical-sized glossy coral, sage and ivory breakable bricks. Their rope pulleys, hanging stone counterweights and wide spillway openings are visible. One raft leans slightly because a ball knocked its weight free; a low broad surge curves around the raft and drains through an opened gate. The water forms a readable low-contrast dark teal physical volume, with bounded pale foam near real contacts; the bright white ball remains clear against it. The crab's broad shell/claws stay directly reachable by ordinary ball hits. Empty clear lower quarter, low paddle, and Kit face-only orb lowerleft remain as specified.
RIGHT: large premium three-quarter full Nerra render with all original crab anatomy, convincing heavy shell/stone-tower weight, slick glossy coral shell and expressive menacing face, one massive crusher claw and one slender gate-handling claw. Three physical motion studies labelled only "CLAMP", "SURGE", "DRAIN": claw closes a sluice; raft and ballast respond to a water surge; ball releases the counterweight and gate opens, crab rocked backward by draining water. Small optional power vignette: Kit uses a tangible engraved dark silver ANCHOR with a short stout chain to reverse the sluice wheel, not a magical connecting beam; a broad whirl of water drains away. Show clear physical cause and effect rather than a perfect neon circle.
Art priorities: beautiful playable full-screen portrait, identifiable unique crab silhouette/eyes/claws, usable broad ordinary-ball routes, equal brick geometry and generous reaction space, layered water/raft depth without obscuring ball. No snake/ape/yeti or copied game characters, no spaceship, no huge moon, no dazzling flood glow, no flat cartoon clip-art.
